sections: Interactions with our features that are part of AI at Meta

hunks.section: Interactions with our features that are part of AI at Meta
hunks.lead: When you or others use, or exchange information with these features, or when they perform actions, we collect and use information, such as:
lines: *   Information from third-party apps and services you choose to connect to these features to do things like help manage your calendar and emails
*   Feedback you give to these features and responses to your feedback

*   Information about you and others from third party apps and services that you connect to Meta Products to enhance your experience, including our features that are part of AI at Meta. [Learn more](https://mbasic.facebook.com/privacy/policy/printable/?entry_point=POLICY_ANNOTATION%3A1.ex.62-InformationYouOrOthersExchange#4.subpage.15-AiIntegrations)
